applicable_when: The kernel transposes a tensor from NHWC-like layout (strides: 290400,1,5280,96) to NCHW layout (strides: 290400,3025,55,1). The load address is y0 + 96*x2 + 290400*y1 where x2 is the spatial index (XBLOCK dimension). With XBLOCK=128, consecutive threads in the X-warp load elements separated by stride 96 in memory (non-contiguous), causing severe uncoalesced reads. Meanwhile y0 = yindex % 96 is the channel index which IS stride-1 in the input, so YBLOCK threads load contiguous memory. The fix is to increase YBLOCK (channels, stride-1 in input) and decrease XBLOCK (spatial, stride-96 in input) so that warps read contiguous memory. @triton.autotune will find the optimal balance automatically.
